realized_metrics.window_convention: WP-12dm / WP-S2c-76 uses the prior contiguous local data-year evaluation window, 2024-04-12 through 2025-04-11, as H-003 combined R1+R2 cycle 2 after WP-12dl cycle 1 used 2025-04-12 through 2026-04-11. Indicators are warmed up on prior available 1d history, but the backtest window starts flat with no pre-window position carry-in. The original H-003 REP-0004 evidence used a full-period retrospective posture, so strict non-overlap against that baseline is impossible; this report records explicit non-cloned bounded-window disclosure for additional REP evidence.

metric_comparisons.comparison_notes: EXP-0004 requires OOS Sharpe >= 1.0 net of modeled costs; OL-0029 records sharpe above that threshold.
EXP-0004 requires dsr_val > 0.95; OL-0029 records dsr above that threshold.
EXP-0004 requires max drawdown <= 20%; OL-0029 records max_drawdown above that threshold.
EXP-0004 requires parameter sensitivity min_ratio >= 0.70; OL-0029 records sensitivity_min_ratio above that threshold.
EXP-0004 requires cost drag <= 50% of gross PnL; OL-0029 records cost_drag_fraction below that threshold with positive gross PnL.
EXP-0004 requires walk-forward efficiency > 0.5; OL-0029 records walk_forward_efficiency above that threshold.

interpretation: REC-0046 derives from OL-0029 and is the WP-S2c-76 H-003 exp_success_criteria cycle 2 REC under approved combined R1+R2 methodology. It is exact-segment evidence only for H-003 / research_oos / pre_wp_5b / exp_success_criteria, increasing that exact segment count from 2 to 3 / REC-5 floor if validation confirms. That exact-segment floor evidence is descriptive only, does not complete H-003, and does not complete A2C-002. OL-0029 is reused by REC-0045 for the separate d2_006_gates exact segment under R1 paired-source reuse; separate REC artifacts and separate expectation-source comparisons preserve exact-segment separation. REC-0046 does not create H-003 completion, A2C-002 completion, Path B, policy, scoring, ranking/recommendation, paper-live/runtime, lifecycle, promotion, demotion, protected-path authority, or downstream authority.
